caption: The drawing depicts a scene with a large central stag with antlers, shown in mid-leap, colored in shades of light pink with brownish accents to indicate details such as its fur and muscles. The stag is being pursued by four dogs, also rendered in similar pink and brown tones, with their bodies extended as if in full chase, positioned both ahead of and behind the stag. The background consists of several stylized trees with brown trunks and branches, and foliage in brownish-green tones. The ground is depicted with a band of pink and brown, indicating soil and plants. The sky and general background are filled in a solid yellow color, with no indication of clouds or other sky elements. The rectangular scene is bordered by a white margin, and the overall composition has a flat, two-dimensional quality, with simplified forms and consistent coloring throughout.
title: Bandbox Design
